iran.name: Iran official (Sayyed Khamenei's office)
iran.description: Month starts published in Iran from real crescent sightings (telescopes accepted). Exact from published data through Shawwal 1447; later months are calculated (91% exact, otherwise ±1 day).

fadlallah.name: Sayyed Fadlallah's office
fadlallah.description: Astronomical calculation: the month begins once the crescent can be seen with the naked eye anywhere that shares the night with Lebanon.

sistani.name: Sayyed Sistani's office
sistani.description: Naked-eye sighting on the same horizon, calculated for Najaf. The office's announcement may differ by a day.

ummalqura.name: Umm al-Qura (Saudi Arabia)
ummalqura.description: Saudi Arabia's official calculated calendar, for reference.

home.subtitle: Gregorian ⇄ Hijri
home.eveHint: The Islamic night began at Maghrib; the date changes at midnight.
home.maghribAt: Maghrib in Beirut at {{time}} — the night of the next Hijri day begins then
home.convertHint: Converts the picked date and scrolls to the result
home.staleResult: The date above changed — showing the previous result. Press Convert to update.

between.title: Days between
between.reversed: The “from” date is after the “to” date.

settings.title: Settings
settings.followSystemHint: Switches between light and dark with your phone
settings.methodHint: Which authority's calendar to follow. Shia authorities can start a month a day apart.
settings.adjustmentHint: If your local announcement differs from the calculation, shift every Hijri date by up to two days.
settings.aboutBody: Converts dates between the Gregorian and Hijri calendars following Shia calendar authorities, fully offline. Iran's official dates come from the published record; the other methods compute crescent visibility astronomically (Odeh's criterion).
settings.credits: Iranian month data: the qamari project (CC0). Astronomy: astronomy-engine (MIT).
settings.disclaimer: Calculated dates can differ by a day from what your marja's office announces, especially for future months. Follow the official announcement for religious obligations.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: Convert any date between the Gregorian and Hijri calendars, the way the Shia community counts the months.

convert.title: Both directions
convert.body: Choose “To Hijri” or “To Gregorian” and turn the wheels. The result updates instantly, and you can copy or share it.

methods.title: Your marja's calendar
methods.body: Months start by crescent sighting, so authorities can differ by a day. Iran's official calendar is the default; switch to Fadlallah, Sistani or Umm al-Qura, or adjust by ±2 days, in Settings.

occasions.title: Occasions and nights
occasions.body: See Shia occasions on any date, what's coming next, and when tonight is already the eve of the next Hijri day after Maghrib.
